create_pg_solver: create a Policy Gradient solver with configurable learning rates and gradient projection
compute_gradients: compute exploitability gradients for policy distributions over payoff matrices
run_pg_solver: run the PG solver to compute gradients and exploitability estimates for a game
test_pg_solver: test the PG solver's exploitability method returns NaN as expected
review_gradients: review the gradients function that computes per-player gradient estimates from payoff matrices
